notes: No waw opens the apodosis, so *Then* is `added` (rule 14).

Both third-person suffixes are left unrendered: the ASV writes a supplied *the* on each noun (rule 15), and rule 18 places only a pronoun the ASV has actually written, so each suffix is its own `unrepresented` unit (rule 22).
*the shoulder blade* heads on *shoulder*, since *blade* is the supplied generic (rule 31).
